title: The step
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Monday. The garage's one step. The pup takes it with a scuttle and a hop, differently each time. Four panels, four ways up one step. Never remarked.

panels.composition: The garage's single concrete step. BARNABY II at its foot. Up: front paws, then the hind leg, a hop.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged puppy hopping up a single concrete step with its front paws first, no words

panels.composition: Down: a scuttle, sideways, faster than up.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, the same puppy scuttling sideways down the step, no words

panels.composition: Up again: a different way. Hind leg first this time. It works too.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, the same puppy going up the step hind leg first, a different method, no words

panels.composition: The pup at the top, sitting, pleased. WOOD in the doorway behind him with coffee, having watched all four. Saying nothing. The strip saying nothing.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged puppy sitting pleased at the top of a step while a man with coffee stands in the doorway behind having watched, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Wordless. Four ways up one step.
